prediction.rationale:
Cooler: reduced efficiency. Evidence: TS4 mean temperature 40.3 °C (30% above healthy); TS1 mean temperature 44.8 °C (25% above healthy); TS3 mean temperature 47.0 °C (21% above healthy). Thermal dissipation is sub-optimal, allowing gradual temperature elevation during continuous load cycles.
Valve: close to total failure. Evidence: PS1/PS2 valve switching lag 10.1 s (3% above healthy); PS2 pressure rise time 9.70 s (5% above healthy). Substantial delay in circuit pressurization confirms delayed spool actuation in the main valve.
Pump leakage: weak leakage. Evidence: FS1 mean volume flow 6.43 l/min (2% below healthy); EPS1/FS1 power-to-flow ratio 385 W·min/l (within 1% of healthy); SE system efficiency factor 56.6 % (3% below healthy). Slight elevation in power-to-flow ratio reflects incipient volumetric efficiency loss.
Accumulator: slightly reduced. Evidence: PS2 pressure ripple 46.9 bar (within 1% of healthy). Slight increase in pressure oscillations indicates reduced surge dampening capacity.

tslm_prediction.rationale:
Cooler: reduced efficiency. Evidence: TS4 mean temperature 40.1 °C (29% above healthy); TS1 mean temperature 44.6 °C (24% above healthy); TS3 mean temperature 46.9 °C (20% above healthy). Moderate fluid temperature rise and diminished heat exchange indicate degraded cooler efficiency.
Valve: close to total failure. Evidence: PS1/PS2 valve switching lag 10.1 s (3% above healthy); PS2 pressure rise time 9.69 s (4% above healthy). Transient response is severely sluggish, preventing timely transition of working pressure.
Pump leakage: severe leakage. Evidence: FS1 mean volume flow 6.33 l/min (4% below healthy); EPS1/FS1 power-to-flow ratio 390 W·min/l (2% above healthy); SE system efficiency factor 55.4 % (6% below healthy). Motor draws full electrical power while circuit flow drops substantially, confirming internal fluid bypassing.
Accumulator: slightly reduced. Evidence: PS2 pressure ripple 46.8 bar (within 1% of healthy). Elevated pressure ripple across working lines indicates moderate degradation of accumulator pre-charge.
